## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, what happens today, and what happens after this change.

## Scope and spec

Link the spec for a substantial change. Describe the intended scope and any remaining limitation.

## Root cause and regression test

For a bug fix, state the root cause and identify the test that failed before the fix. For other changes, explain how the new behavior is tested.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. Include verify, tests and pret. State which checks could not run and why.

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implementation.
- [ ] The diff contains no personal data, credentials or local configuration.
- [ ] The change is ready for independent review.
